extension.summary: Watch your Frigate cameras in Kodi
extension.description: Watch the cameras of a self-hosted Frigate NVR live, and play back the clips of its recent review items. View only: nothing is changed on the server.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a Frigate server (0.14 or newer) that you own or have an account on. Not affiliated with the Frigate project.
extension.news: v0.1.0 - First release: live view and review clips
